comment: Master declaration for the manifold fleet (#418). Git, not the vault, owns hub discovery: changing the master is a reviewed commit, so vault write access can never repoint fleet terminals. The owner key stays in Bitwarden under vaultItemName and is read only by the one-time interactive `atyrode runtime provision manifold-agent`; the running agent needs only its 0600 machine token file. supportedSystems mirrors the upstream flake's filled bun-deps hashes (manifold flake.nix depsHashes); widen it only after the corresponding hash lands upstream.
